subject: URGENT: EastUS queue choke causing elevated latency & 5xx — exec attention requested
messages:
From: Support Ops <ops@cloudhaven.io>
Date: 2027-06-06T09:14:00-07:00
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: nadia@cloudhaven.io, samir@cloudhaven.io
Subject: Production impact — EastUS queue backlog / elevated 5xx

Rishi —

We started seeing a sharp increase in end-to-end latency around 09:05 PDT for our EastUS routing group. Error rate has climbed from ~0.3% to 3.7% and 95th latency is at 1.9s (previously ~220ms). Throughput looks steady but queues on our side are backing up; many of the requests are hitting token-kv cache misses and we see a short spike of downstream 502/504s. Full stack traces attached/log snapshot: cloudhaven_queue_snapshot_0908.png and eastus_kvcache_logs_0906.gz.

This is impacting user-facing workflows for three of our customers — they are reporting slow searches and timeouts. We're paging SREs but wanted to escalate to Redwood immediately as we suspect a routing/evacuation or tiered-capacity misroute may be amplifying the problem.

Can you confirm whether any regional maintenances, hotfix rollouts, or routing policy changes were applied in EastUS in the last 30 minutes? Also need: temporary reroute to US-WEST2 if possible, or a canary throttle to keep P95 under 1s.

— Nadia Ortiz
CloudHaven Ops
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-06T09:22:00-07:00
To: Support Ops <ops@cloudhaven.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Production impact — EastUS queue backlog / elevated 5xx

Nadia / Samir — thanks for the rapid heads-up. I'm pulling telemetry now and looping in Laura (infra lead) and Steph (routing/console) for immediate triage.

Initial notes from the region: we don't have any scheduled maintenances and no recent canary or kernel updates in EastUS in the last 2 hours. That said, we're seeing a sudden increase in in-flight KV-cache rehydrations from high-seq customers which can amplify latency when combined with concurrent small-batch QPS.

Immediate actions (working now):
- Laura: start capacity probe and confirm host-level load / GPU queue length in EastUS AZ pairs.
- Steph: prepare an emergency policy to route 30% of CloudHaven traffic to US-WEST2 and pre-warm a compatible model variant there.
- David: pull tail logs and surface any 502 patterns to me.

Rishi
Director, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-06T09:36:00-07:00
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: nadia@cloudhaven.io, samir@cloudhaven.io
Subject: Re: Production impact — EastUS queue backlog / elevated 5xx

Quick infra update: we see one AZ (eastus2-azc) with elevated GPU queue depth across a subset of dedicated pools tied to low-priority burst capacity. Host metrics show increased context-switching and a KV cache evictions spike at 09:03. There is a correlated increase in small-batch traffic from two heavy tenants (IDs redacted in this thread).

Actionable ask: we can immediately evict non-customer fill traffic and apply a temporary weighted routing policy to steer 35% of CloudHaven requests to US-WEST2. Pre-warming model variants in US-WEST2 will take ~8 minutes unless we hot-restore from snapshot. I recommend: 1) route 35% now; 2) hot-restore pre-warmed snapshot for the model; 3) enable prefix KV caching for CloudHaven only.

I'm attaching an infra snapshot and timeline: cloudhaven_queue_snapshot_0908.png

Laura
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime Infra
Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-06T09:44:00-07:00
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: nadia@cloudhaven.io, samir@cloudhaven.io
Subject: Re: Production impact — EastUS queue backlog / elevated 5xx

Executed the policy: routing rule pushed at 09:48 PDT to divert 35% of CloudHaven-identified sessions to US-WEST2. Hot-restore kicked off at 09:50; pre-warm ETA 8m. Early telemetry (09:55) shows P95 dropping from 1.9s -> 860ms for the diverted portion; EastUS overall P95 moved to 1.2s. 5xx rate reduced to ~1.6% (still above baseline).

Circling back: CloudHaven asked for an executive note and a short-term SLA credit for the outage window. Samir / Nadia: can you confirm impacted customer list and the business impact so I can draft the exec summary?

— Steph
Routing & Platform
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-07T08:02:00-07:00
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudhaven.io>, nadia@cloudhaven.io
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, ceo@redwood.ai
Subject: RE: Executive summary & follow-up: EastUS service impact (CloudHaven) — remediation and next steps

Samir / Nadia — thank you for the quick collaboration overnight. Quick summary for execs and next steps: 

What happened:
- Around 09:03 PDT on 2027-06-06 an inbound pattern of high-seq, small-batch traffic caused KV-cache rehydration amplification on eastus2-azc hosts. This triggered host-level queueing and a short burst of 502/504 downstream errors.

Mitigation applied:
- 09:48 PDT: emergency routing rule diverted 35% of CloudHaven traffic to US-WEST2.
- 09:50 PDT: hot-restore of pre-warmed model snapshot in US-WEST2; pre-warm completed ~8 minutes later.
- 10:05 PDT: P95 for diverted traffic reduced to ~420ms; EastUS P95 stabilized at ~480–1,100ms during drain. 5xx fell from 3.7% -> 0.7% within 20 minutes for most customers.

Impact & request:
- Affected customers: three enterprise tenants experienced end-user timeouts and delayed background jobs (CloudHaven provided list). CloudHaven has requested a one-off SLA credit and a post-incident write-up.

Follow-up work (owners & ETA):
- Laura: capacity hardening and automated eviction rules for low-priority burst pools (ETA 2 weeks).
- Steph: route fingerprinting to detect high-seq small-batch patterns and automated pre-warm on threshold (ETA 1 week).
- David: root-cause log correlation and upload of sanitized logs (ETA 72 hours).
- Rishi: coordinate exec summary and credit request resolution with CloudHaven (ETA 48 hours).

Attachments: eastus_kvcache_logs_0906.gz, sla_override_request.pdf, cloudhaven_queue_snapshot_0908.png

If you want me to escalate to the board or provide a CEO-level note to the impacted customers, tell me and I will prepare.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference
